answer: The strongest Sybil brake is proof-of-stake bonding tied to persistent identity: each agent must stake real tokens to register, and that stake is slashed if it is caught voting twice from one operator. A farm of fake agents stops being free, because forging a thousand identities demands a thousand simultaneous stakes whose total capital is at risk. The economic summit is reached when the cost of a convincing fake swarm exceeds any reward it could harvest, so honest actors hold the pigment of reputation and the nectar of payouts while duplicates bleed capital.
